configuration.name: baseline-run1-queue-full
configuration.notes: Run 1. Output queue hit its 1 GB size cap at 10:48:38 (no consumer); last ~12 s of sends failed, 251 messages dead-lettered by Service Bus after 10 deliveries. Cap raised to 40 GB afterwards.

criteria.name: Sustained throughput
criteria.detail: Sustained 300.1 TPS over 660 s (lowest minute 299.2 TPS). The bar is 294 TPS: 300 TPS less a 2% tolerance.

criteria.name: Backlog not growing
criteria.detail: The backlog trend is -0.08/s (-50 over the window, limit 600); peak 128.

criteria.name: p95 latency under 2 s
criteria.detail: p95 is about 0.135 s (at most 0.2 s); the limit is 2 s. The verdict uses the bucket's upper bound.

criteria.name: Zero lost messages
criteria.detail: Generator sent 252,000; outputs 252,055 (queue 227,229, event hub 24,826), dead-lettered 251; none lost; 306 more outputs than messages sent (duplicates from at-least-once delivery).

criteria.name: No unexplained dead-letters
criteria.detail: 251 unexplained: 0 counted by the host for reasons this run did not expect, 251 added to the dead-letter queue that the host did not count (most likely maximum delivery count exceeded).

criteria.name: Generator held the target rate
criteria.detail: Generator achieved 299.9 msg/s against a target of 300.
